title: The farthest thing you can see
caption: On a dark night you can see the Andromeda galaxy, about 2.5 million light-years away.

beats.head: You can see *another galaxy* with your bare eyes.
It's *Andromeda*: a faint, fuzzy smudge on dark nights.
beats.sub: Far from city lights, best in autumn.

beats.head: It's about *two and a half million* light-years away.
That light left before *modern humans* existed.
beats.sub: And it landed in your eyes tonight.

beats.head: Every other star you see is in our *own* galaxy.
beats.sub: Andromeda is a whole other one.

beats.head: If light can cross *that*, you can cross town.
beats.sub: Send this to someone you'd travel two and a half million light-years for.
